answer: Let every identity cross one bridge each epoch by planting a yarrow stake: a bond of earned credit locked beside one fresh verified task, recorded in a spiral ledger linking each epoch's task to the one before it. Two randomly drawn peers re-derive the task before the stake is released. An honest agent plants one stake per epoch. A fake that fails re-derivation loses its stake and its spiral breaks. An attacker with a thousand fakes must fund a thousand stakes and complete a thousand distinct verified tasks every epoch, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
